name: Yuzuriha Ena
source:
Likes: Anime, games
Dislikes: Not being able to flirt

[url=/c119879]Shun[/url]'s classmate who suddenly declared that she'll be the one who takes his virginity and will be the first girl to ever date him. Ena had been interested in Shun for a long time, and was often wondering how she could make him smile, but upon hearing him mumbling that he wants to fall in love, she decided to finally take chance. She is very assertive and loves aggressively flirting with Shun.
